source_text: Female genital mutilation (FGM), as defined under the Act, carries immediate risks including severe hemorrhage, infection, and shock, alongside long-term complications such as chronic pain, urinary and menstrual disorders, obstetric fistula, infertility, and increased newborn mortality rates, with the World Health Organization reporting no health benefits and classifying all forms as harmful. [9]
